news.title: Apple “Has No Idea What It’s Doing” in AI. Oh, and It’s Building Its Own AI Agent Too
news.summary: Key TakeawaysApple is building its own AI agent that can run devices, browse the web and write code, which puts it up against Anthropic, OpenAI and Alphabet’s Google. Apple trades at 37x forward earnings, the price of a company that collects fees from AI, yet its agent will start from models rebuilt on Google’s Gemini.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Apple 正在打造自己的 AI 代理程式，能夠操作裝置、瀏覽網頁和撰寫程式碼，這使其與 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Alphabet 旗下的 Google 形成競爭。Apple 的交易價格為 37x 遠期盈利倍數，這是一家從 AI 收取費用的公司的估值，然而其代理程式將基於 Google 的 Gemini 重建模型起步。

news.summary: Warren Buffett told CNBC in 2019 that Berkshire had never bought a new issue in 54 years. news.title: Alibaba AI Cloud Revenue Surges 53% as Quarterly Earnings Miss Analyst Forecasts
news.summary: Alibaba Group (NYSE:BABA) reported a 53% increase in revenue from its AI Cloud and Compute Services business during the September quarter, supported by strong demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure and computing services. news.summary_zh: 10 年期債券收益率收於 November 20, 2026，報 4.92%；而 2 年期債券收益率收於 4.63%。

news.title: The Fed’s Biggest Dove Sees No Clear Path Back to 2% Inflation
news.summary: When even a policymaker known for patience starts sounding alarmed, bond buyers lose a key ally. Goolsbee's warning raises a harder question for anyone holding long Treasuries: what happens if the Fed's last dove stops defending them?
news.title_zh: 聯準會最大鴿派人物看不出回歸 2% 通膨的明確路徑
news.summary_zh: 當連以耐心著稱的決策者開始發出警訊時，債券買家就失去了一位關鍵盟友。古爾斯比的警告對持有長期公債的任何人提出了更棘手的問題：如果聯準會最後一位鴿派人物停止為它們護航，會發生什麼？

news.title: Portfolio Intelligence: Rates Have Increased. Do You Know Where Your Bond Fund Is?
news.summary: The reasons for including bonds in a portfolio justifiably varyâ reducing equity volatility, generating income, and accessing opportunity among them.
news.title_zh: 投資組合智慧：利率已上升。你知道你的債券基金在哪裡嗎？
news.summary_zh: 將債券納入投資組合的理由合理且多樣——降低股票波動、創造收入、以及把握機會等。

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.
news.title_zh: 在 3 風險層級的每月檢視：VTEB、TLT 與 EMB 排名
news.summary_zh: 退休族的每月債券基金檢視可能看似穩定，但背後的股價卻悄悄崩塌。根據兩種風險對三檔熱門配息基金排名，產生兩份方向相反的名單，且有一檔基金從安全變得驚悚。

news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.title: The AI Selloff May Be Over. Here Are 3 Reasons Why
news.summary: Hawkish Fed repricing, surging bond yields and dollar strength have pressured AI; stabilizing yields and a dollar peak could support a rebound.
news.title_zh: AI 拋售潮可能已結束。以下為 3 項原因
news.summary_zh: 聯準會鷹派重新定價、債券殖利率飆升與美元走強打壓 AI；殖利率企穩與美元見頂可能支撐反彈。

news.title: Fed Eyes Bigger Hikes As Bond Market, Oil And Copper Signal Inflation Is Already Fading
news.summary: The Fed is talking about hiking more aggressively, into an economy it's already slowing and an inflation problem the market says is already fading.
news.title_zh: 聯準會關注更大幅度加息，因債券市場、石油與銅價顯示通膨已開始消退
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正討論更激進地加息，進入一個其已放緩的經濟，以及市場認為已開始消退的通膨問題。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: Mets Owner Steve Cohen’s Fund Dumped Nearly All of Its AMD and Bet $1 Billion That Microsoft Is the Safer AI Stock. AMD Has Fallen 31% Since
news.summary: Steve Cohen's Point72 sold 99% of its AMD shares in the third quarter and raised its Microsoft stake from 31,522 shares to 2,055,578, about $1 billion of buying, its Nov. 16 13F shows. AMD has fallen 31% since Sept. 30 and Microsoft 6%. The same filing tripled Intel, which has since lost more than half its value.

news.summary: Nebius fell 16% on Friday to $81.31, 72% below its June record and below where it ended 2025. Michael Burry posted that he tried to warn investors about Nebius, CoreWeave and Nvidia.

news.summary_zh: Dan Ives 在 Jensen Huang 辭去 CEO 後，修正了他對 Nvidia 股票的目標價。

news.title: Prediction: Nvidia Stock Will Do This in the 6 Months After a New CEO Takes Over, According to History
news.summary: Nvidia is searching for a new CEO following Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation.

news.summary_zh: Nvidia 正在尋找新 CEO，因為 Jensen Huang 突然辭職。

news.title: NVDA Stock Clocks Worst Week In 18 Years As SEC Reportedly Probes Its Accounting Practices
news.summary: SEC is scrutinizing Nvidia’s accounting practices, Reuters reported, citing two people familiar with the matter.
news.title_zh: NVDA 股票錄得 18 年來最差一週，因 SEC 據報正調查其會計做法
news.summary_zh: 據路透社報導，引述兩位知情人士，SEC 正在嚴查 Nvidia 的會計做法。

news.title: Data Center AI Chips Could Change the Winners: Broadcom and Marvell
news.summary: While investors fixate on Nvidia's share price, hyperscalers are quietly buying different chips for different jobs. Counting accelerators misses the real money, and a memory-stack model shows why the chip tally can mislead.
news.title_zh: 資料中心 AI 晶片可能改變贏家：Broadcom 和 Marvell
news.summary_zh: 當投資者專注於 Nvidia 的股價時，超大規模雲端業者正悄悄購買不同晶片以應對不同任務。僅計算加速器會錯失真正的商機，記憶體堆疊模型顯示為何晶片數量統計可能誤導。

news.title: Mets Owner Steve Cohen’s Fund Dumped Nearly All of Its AMD and Bet $1 Billion That Microsoft Is the Safer AI Stock. AMD Has Fallen 31% Since
news.summary: Steve Cohen's Point72 sold 99% of its AMD shares in the third quarter and raised its Microsoft stake from 31,522 shares to 2,055,578, about $1 billion of buying, its Nov. 16 13F shows. AMD has fallen 31% since Sept. 30 and Microsoft 6%. The same filing tripled Intel, which has since lost more than half its value.
news.title_zh: 大都會隊老闆史蒂夫·科恩的基金拋售幾乎所有 AMD，並押注 $1 Billion 微軟是更安全的 AI 股票。AMD 自那以來下跌 31%
news.summary_zh: 史蒂夫·科恩的 Point72 在第三季出售了 99% 的 AMD 股份，並將微軟持股從 31,522 股增加到 2,055,578 股，買入金額約 $1 billion，其 Nov. 16 13F 文件顯示。AMD 自 Sept. 30 以來下跌 31%，而微軟 6%。同一份文件顯示英特爾持股增加三倍，但其後市值蒸發超過一半。

news.title: Trump’s Treasury Secretary Keeps Nvidia’s H200 China Policy as House Data Show Nearly 880,000 AI Chips Approved
news.summary: Key TakeawaysHouse data show Commerce approved nearly 880,000 NVIDIA and AMD AI chips for China from December to May. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he doesn’t expect the H200 policy to change.
news.title_zh: 川普的財政部長維持輝達 H200 中國政策，眾議院數據顯示近 880,000 顆 AI 晶片獲批

news.title: AMD Is Down 26% and Intel Is Down 42%. Which AI Stock Is Worth Buying on the Dip?
news.summary: As Wall Street reassesses the economics of the AI boom, the differences between these two chipmakers are becoming increasingly important.
news.title_zh: AMD 下跌 26% 而英特爾下跌 42%。哪檔 AI 股票值得在跌勢中買進？
news.summary_zh: 隨著華爾街重新評估 AI 繁榮的經濟性，這兩家晶片製造商之間的差異變得愈發重要。

news.title: Stock Market Midday, Nov. 20: Nasdaq Plunges Nearly 3% as AMD and Micron Lead a Brutal Semiconductor Sell-Off
news.summary: Mounting regulatory concerns, elevated valuations, and uncertainty surrounding interest rates are putting some of Wall Street's biggest winners of the AI boom under considerable pressure.
news.title_zh: 股市盤中，Nov. 20：納斯達克暴跌近 3%，AMD 和美光領跌慘烈半導體賣盤
news.summary_zh: 日增的監管憂慮、高估值，以及利率不確定性，正讓華爾街 AI 熱潮中的最大贏家承受相當大壓力。

news.title: Trump Bought Up to $265,000 of NVIDIA Stock. Here’s Where the Price Target Stands
news.summary: A presidential stock purchase lands the same week NVIDIA loses its CEO and sinks toward a 52-week low. Behind the chaos sits a record quarter and a valuation that looks oddly cheap next to AMD and Broadcom.
news.title_zh: Trump 買入高達 $265,000 的 NVIDIA 股票。這裡是目標價的現況
news.summary_zh: 總統買入股票的消息傳出的同一週，NVIDIA 失去 CEO 並跌向 52 週低點。混亂背後是創紀錄的季度業績，以及與 AMD 和 Broadcom 相比顯得異常便宜的估值。

news.title: AMD Sinks Another 4% as Chip Rout Deepens After Short Report Flags “Its Own China Problem”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell another 4% today, after an 8% drop on Hunterbrook Media’s report tying its firmware to a blacklisted Chinese server maker. Arm and Navitas fell too, so the selling looks bigger than AMD.
news.title_zh: AMD 再度下跌 4% 晶片股崩盤加深 空頭報告指稱「自身中國問題」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 今日再跌 4%，此前因 Hunterbrook Media 報告將其韌體與被列入黑名單的中國伺服器製造商連結，股價下跌 8%。Arm 和 Navitas 也下跌，因此拋售範圍似乎超出 AMD。

news.title: AMD Slides 6% Despite Jim Cramer Calling Hunterbrook Short Report a ‘Hitjob’; NVIDIA Falls 3% Near Damodaran’s $140 Buy Price, Intel Declines 2%
news.summary: A short seller says AMD's ties to a blacklisted Chinese server maker expose it to export crackdowns, and a famous TV defender can't stop the bleeding. Now NVIDIA and Intel are caught in the same China-driven chip selloff.
news.title_zh: AMD 下滑 6% 儘管吉姆·克拉默稱亨特布魯克做空報告為「打擊行動」；輝達跌至 3% 接近達莫達蘭的 $140 買入價格，英特爾下跌 2%
news.summary_zh: 一名做空者稱 AMD 與一家被列入黑名單的中國伺服器製造商的關係使其面臨出口打壓，一位知名電視評論員也無法阻止股價下跌。現在輝達和英特爾也陷入同樣由中國驅動的晶片拋售潮中。

news.title: The U.S. Approved 879,000 Nvidia and AMD Chips for China in 6 Months
news.summary: Newly released Commerce Department records show who Washington quietly cleared to buy advanced AI chips, and some names appear on the Pentagon's military company list. Nvidia's guidance says it doesn't matter, but a December hearing could change that.
news.title_zh: 美國在 6 個月內批准 879,000 輝達和 AMD 晶片銷往中國
news.summary_zh: 新發布的商務部記錄顯示，華府悄悄批准哪些買方可購買先進AI晶片，部分名稱出現在五角大樓的軍事企業名單上。輝達指稱這不影響指引，但十二月的聽證會可能改變局勢。

news.title: If AMD Grows at 15% a Year, Here’s What $5,000 Could Become by 2030
news.summary: AMD has more than doubled this year, yet the models behind its stock see a surprisingly wide gap between the best and worst outcomes. Which path your money follows depends on one stubborn question about AI demand and a valuation that already prices in plenty.
news.title_zh: 若 AMD 每年按 15% 成長，這裡展示 $5,000 到 2030 可能變成什麼樣
news.summary_zh: AMD 今年股價翻倍以上，但其股價背後的模型顯示最佳與最差結果之間存在驚人差距。您的資金將走向哪條路徑，取決於一個關於 AI 需求的棘手問題，以及已經包含大量預期的估值。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says He’s Buying AMD After a Short Seller’s 15% Hit
news.summary: A short report wiped out AMD's entire post-earnings gain in one session, yet its own author admits he can't say whether any rule was broken. Does a case that thin deserve a buyer's attention, or is Washington the real threat?
news.title_zh: Jim Cramer 表示在做空者 15% 打擊後買入 AMD
news.summary_zh: 一份做空報告在一個交易時段內抹平 AMD 所有財報後漲幅，但其作者自己承認無法說明是否違反任何規則。這麼薄弱的案例值得買方關注，還是華盛頓才是真正威脅？

news.title: AMD Stock Drops Another 7% Before the Bell and Taiwan Semiconductor Slides 4.2% as Nasdaq Futures Fall 1.6% After Asia’s Chip Selloff
news.summary: AMD was down another 7% before Friday's opening bell and Taiwan Semiconductor 4.2% after Taiwan's worst week since 1991. Nasdaq 100 futures were down 1.6% while Dow futures were flat. Here is what Asia's selloff means for the U.S. open.
news.title_zh: AMD 股票開盤前再跌 7%，台積電下滑 4.2%，納斯達克期貨跌 1.6%，亞洲晶片拋售後
news.summary_zh: AMD 在週五開盤鐘響前再跌 7%，台積電 4.2%，此前台灣經歷自 1991 以來最糟一週。納斯達克 100 期貨下跌 1.6%，道瓊期貨持平。這裡說明亞洲拋售對美股開盤的意義。

news.title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
news.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.
news.title_zh: Marvell 和 Intel 腰斬：多久才能回升？
news.summary_zh: 自六月以來，Marvell 和 Intel 都已損失超過一半價值。在 Nov 17 星期二收盤時，Marvell 報 $148.74。這比其在 June 4 的高點收盤價 $316.43 低 53.0%。Intel 收於 $55.17，比其 June 22 高點低 60.9%。關於晶片股拋售的大多數論調要么是逢低買入的呼籲，要么是 AI 交易結束的警告。本文探討一個更窄的問題：當晶片股腰斬時，有多大機率能回到高點，以及需要多久時間。

news.title: Lumentum Is Down 33% in a Month as Marvell’s Slide Shrinks Its Buyout Value. Can LITE Stock Get Back to Bernstein’s $700 Target?

news.title: Micron Is Down 32% in a Month. Can MU Stock Get Back to $1,000?
news.summary: A 12% single-day plunge has wiped out billions in Micron's value just as UBS questions whether AI spending can ever pay for itself. The memory giant's bulls have committed shipments on their side, but one upcoming test could decide everything.
news.title_zh: Micron 一個月下跌 32%。MU 股票能回到 $1,000 嗎？
news.summary_zh: 單日暴跌 12% 讓 Micron 蒸發數十億美元市值，正值 UBS 質疑 AI 支出是否終能自給自足。這家記憶體巨頭的多頭有出貨承諾撐腰，但即將到來的一項測試可能決定一切。

news.title: Micron’s President Says “We Can’t Support Every Customer.” Apple Just Locked In Samsung’s DRAM
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron’s president said the company “can’t support every customer,” as Apple reportedly nears a Samsung DRAM deal with the price left open. In a memory shortage that Micron says runs for years, suppliers hold the leverage, which helps explain Micron’s 80.
news.title_zh: 美光總裁稱「我們無法支援每位客戶」。蘋果剛鎖定三星 DRAM
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要美光總裁表示該公司「無法支援每位客戶」，據報導蘋果即將與三星達成 DRAM 交易，價格未定。美光表示記憶體短缺將持續數年，供應商掌握主導權，這有助於解釋美光的 80。

news.title: Micron Stock Plunges 13% as Barron’s Calls Memory Stocks ‘Agonizingly Cheap’; Western Digital, SanDisk and Seagate Sink in AI Chip Selloff
news.summary: Micron fell 13% on Friday and sits 50% below its June record as Barron's calls memory stocks "agonizingly cheap." The stock's last two busts ended after drops of 50% and 54%. Here is the case for and against.
news.title_zh: Micron 股價暴跌 13%，因 Barron's 稱記憶體股「極其便宜」；Western Digital、SanDisk 和 Seagate 在 AI 晶片拋售中下跌
news.summary_zh: Micron 週五下跌 13%，並較六月紀錄低 50%，因 Barron's 稱記憶體股票「便宜得讓人痛苦」。該股票上兩次暴跌分別在下跌 50% 和 54% 後結束。這裡是正反雙方的論點。

news.title: Prediction: This Is What Will Happen to Micron’s Stock Price in December
news.summary: The memory specialist has taken a beating in recent months, but it could get a nice shot in the arm when it releases its quarterly results next month.
news.title_zh: 預測：美光股價在十二月將發生什麼事
news.summary_zh: 這家記憶體大廠近幾月遭重挫，但下個月發布季報時可能獲得強力提振。

news.title: Stock Market Midday, Nov. 20: Nasdaq Plunges Nearly 3% as AMD and Micron Lead a Brutal Semiconductor Sell-Off
news.summary: Mounting regulatory concerns, elevated valuations, and uncertainty surrounding interest rates are putting some of Wall Street's biggest winners of the AI boom under considerable pressure.
news.title_zh: 股市盤中，Nov. 20：納斯達克暴跌近 3%，AMD 和美光領跌慘烈半導體賣盤
news.summary_zh: 日增的監管憂慮、高估值，以及利率不確定性，正讓華爾街 AI 熱潮中的最大贏家承受相當大壓力。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysA fund that manages $19. 26 billion made Oracle, Boeing and Micron its three biggest buys of the third quarter, according to its 13F filed Nov.
news.title_zh: 一家 $19 Billion 基金剛剛買入這些 3 股票
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：一家管理 $19 的基金。26 billion 將甲骨文、波音和美光列為第三季三大買入標的，根據其於十一月提交的 13F 文件顯示。

news.title: MU, SNDK, Other Chipmakers Plunge Amid AI Trade Weakness — UBS Says Risk-Reward In Equities Has Become ‘More Balanced’
news.summary: UBS said investors are increasingly questioning whether AI infrastructure spending can generate sufficient returns, but maintains its outlook for further AI investment growth in 2027.
news.title_zh: MU、SNDK 等晶片股因 AI 交易疲軟而暴跌 — 瑞銀表示股票風險報酬已變得「更平衡」
news.summary_zh: 瑞銀表示，投資者越來越質疑 AI 基礎建設支出能否產生足夠回報，但維持對 2027 進一步 AI 投資增長的展望。

news.title: What Happens To Micron Stock If Prices Stop Rising?

news.summary_zh: 今日大事：2027 會成為股市的 2022 重演嗎？

news.title: Micron Sinks 6%, Sandisk Down 7% as Chip Selloff Deepens Memory’s “Abject Disaster”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron Technology fell 6% today as the chip selloff hit memory stocks, Sandisk and SK hynix included. Analysts expect Micron’s EPS to more than double in fiscal 2027, and over 75% of its 2027 output is committed.
news.title_zh: Micron 下跌 6%，Sandisk 下跌 7%，晶片拋售加劇記憶體「慘烈災難」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Micron Technology 今日下跌 6%，晶片拋售波及記憶體股，包含 Sandisk 和 SK hynix。分析師預期 Micron 在財年 2027 EPS 將翻倍以上，且其 2027 產能中超過 75% 已鎖定訂單。

news.title: SanDisk Tumbles 8% as TrendForce Turns Bearish on 2027 NAND Prices; Micron Falls 5%, SK Hynix Slides 4%
news.summary: SanDisk has already lost nearly half its value in a month, and a new price forecast just hit the one product it sells. Can its locked-in data center contracts protect the stock when NAND turns, or do the bears have this right?
news.title_zh: SanDisk 重挫 8%，因 TrendForce 對 2027 NAND 價格轉看空；Micron 下跌 5%，SK Hynix 下滑 4%
news.summary_zh: SanDisk 一個月內已蒸發近半市值，新價格預測直擊其唯一產品。當 NAND 反轉時，其鎖定的資料中心合約能否護航股價，還是空方說法正確？

news.title: Micron’s President Says Memory Has Been Tight “Across Really Multiple Years.” TrendForce Sees DRAM Prices Rising Through 2027
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron’s president said memory has been tight “across really multiple years,” and TrendForce sees DRAM prices holding up through 2027. Micron’s first new Boise fab isn’t expected to produce wafers until mid-2027.
news.title_zh: 美光總裁稱記憶體供應「跨越真正多年」緊俏。集邦科技預測 DRAM 價格將上漲至 2027
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要美光總裁表示記憶體供應「跨越真正多年」緊俏，集邦科技預測 DRAM 價格將維持至 2027。美光首座新的波西廠預計要到 -2027 中才會產出晶圓。

news.title: SanDisk Tumbles 8% as TrendForce Turns Bearish on 2027 NAND Prices; Micron Falls 5%, SK Hynix Slides 4%
news.summary: SanDisk has already lost nearly half its value in a month, and a new price forecast just hit the one product it sells. Can its locked-in data center contracts protect the stock when NAND turns, or do the bears have this right?

news.summary: South Korea's KOSPI and Japan's Nikkei 225 both sank more than 4% on Friday as Wall Street's AI selloff spread to Asia. Samsung, SK hynix and TSMC are about 1.7% of a 2030 target-date fund, and South Korea is 1.38%, so the Seoul drop comes to about $348 on a $500,000 balance.
